diagnoses.description: Total selection is vulnerable to OCR digit-flip outliers when multiple total-like lines exist; a corrupted high-priority line (e.g., “Total Amt Rounded”) can dominate even when other internal anchors (Subtotal/Payment/Total incl) agree on a different value. The skill should explicitly require an anchor-consistency override and warn against majority-vote across OCR variants without anchor checks.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 074.jpg amount_correct=false while date_correct=true. Predictions show 074 total_amount="702.00". The run’s own debugging notes OCR variants can produce both 702.00 and 102.00; the receipt image shows totals around 102.00 and includes multiple confirming anchors (Subtotal/Payment/Total incl). This is a classic OCR digit-flip (1→7) where internal consistency beats keyword priority or variant-majority voting.

diagnoses.description: Total extraction can fail when the ‘Grand Total’ label is OCR-corrupted (e.g., missing space) and/or the amount uses a non-dot decimal separator (e.g., 92:80). Without robust normalization and label-tolerant matching, the extractor may fall back to non-total payment lines (Cash Received) or emit empty/incorrect values. The skill should explicitly add (a) label-tolerant GRAND TOTAL matching, (b) decimal-separator normalization, and (c) stronger exclusions for cash received/tendered lines.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 078.jpg amount_correct=false; predictions show total_amount as empty string "". Timeline OCR for 078 shows lines like "a Total — 92:80" and "GrandTota. = tS 92.80" plus "Cash Received 100.00". This demonstrates two failure modes: (1) keyword corruption (GrandTota.) and (2) punctuation corruption (92:80). The task requires null on failure and exact two-decimal formatting on success; empty string violates schema.

diagnoses.description: Date disambiguation can fail on invoices with multiple date-like strings and OCR-corrupted labels (DATE→DATA). The skill should more mechanically prioritize the primary header ‘Date:’ field over other header-adjacent date-like tokens and recommend top-of-receipt/header-block preference when multiple labeled candidates exist.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 034.jpg date_correct=false while amount_correct=true. The provided image shows a clear header date field, while prior method history indicates OCR can produce alternate labeled lines (e.g., ‘Data: …’) that can be mistakenly selected by naive regex-first or majority voting.

quality_impact.rationale: Directly targets the remaining high-impact failure patterns evidenced in the run: (a) OCR-corrupted GRAND TOTAL label and colon decimal separator (078), and (b) OCR digit-flip outlier where internal anchors agree (074). Also strengthens date disambiguation (034) with a more mechanical header-date preference. These changes are likely to improve exact-match accuracy without harming already-correct receipts.

trigger_precision.rationale: New rules are narrowly scoped to receipt total/date extraction. Label-tolerant GRAND TOTAL matching is constrained to close variants; split-line fallback tightening triggers only in the intended ‘keyword-only line’ scenario; anchor override triggers only when multiple anchors exist and agree.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Uses only permitted evidence (field-level correctness feedback, predictions, and provided OCR snippets/images) and does not reference oracle values. Returns complete replacement content only for the changed existing SKILL.md (image-ocr); other skills untouched.

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Covers: keyword corruption (GrandTota.), punctuation corruption (92:80), payment-line confusion (Cash Received), OCR digit-flip outliers (102→702) via anchor-consistency, and date ambiguity under label corruption (DATE→DATA). Does not attempt unrelated enhancements (deskew/cropping) not implicated by the provided failures.

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: The historical misses are dominated by selection/normalization under OCR noise rather than lack of OCR capability. The minimal transferable repair is to (1) make GRAND TOTAL matching tolerant to common OCR spacing/punctuation errors, (2) tighten the split-line fallback so it cannot jump to payment lines when the keyword line is merely garbled, (3) expand cash-payment exclusions, and (4) explicitly require anchor-consistency overrides to defeat OCR digit-flip outliers even when a high-priority keyword line or variant-majority suggests otherwise.

iteration_summary: Updated only environment/skills/image-ocr/SKILL.md: added label-tolerant GRAND TOTAL matching, tightened split-line fallback trigger, expanded cash-payment exclusions, emphasized anchor-consistency override vs OCR-variant majority voting, and reinforced header-date preference for disambiguation.
